details:
I just got around to testing it in game, and while the ability to interact with the action menu is greatly appreciated here's some thoughts: the ability to change keybinds would be appreciated, looking at the context menu to open is really a bit difficult and (idk if it does this already) the ability to use this with eye tracking would be much better or simply just being able to disable one of the two methods to begin with. 

This brings me to one of the major pain point of this update. The action menu being placed in the world instead of locked on hand. I get that it helps with hand tracking, but it breaks gogoloco, cause any slider that changes levitation height (position on up axis) moves me away from the menus and makes it basically impossible to interact with it unless i close it and then open it back up next to me. this would be better if it stayed on the hand as it normally does with a controller. 

As bonus it would be nice if you could also have the ability to touch the menus with your fingers and just spin any wheel options in the action menu, i feel like this would be much more appropriate for hand tracking.

PS: DLSS when?
title: Feedback on the new hand tracking update.
